source_caption:
📺 The Son (2017–2019)

The Son follows Eli McCullough, a powerful and ruthless Texas rancher whose extraordinary journey from a traumatic childhood to becoming a wealthy oil tycoon shapes the future of his family. Set across two timelines, the series explores Eli’s early years in the 1840s, when he is captured by Comanche warriors and forced to adapt to an unfamiliar way of life, alongside his later years in 1915 as he struggles to protect his growing business empire. As Eli pursues wealth, power, and influence, his decisions create conflicts with rival families, political figures, and even his own children. With violence, betrayal, and family rivalries threatening everything he has built, the McCullough family must confront the consequences of ambition and survival. Starring Pierce Brosnan, Jacob Lofland, and Henry Garrett, the series delivers gripping Western drama, intense action, and emotional storytelling while exploring family, loyalty, identity, power, and the complicated history of the American frontier.

🎭 Genre: Western • Drama • Historical Fiction

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Philipp Meyer, Brian McGreevy & Lee Shipman

📺 Seasons: 2 • 20 Episodes

📚 Based On: The 2013 novel The Son by Philipp Meyer.

📺 Where to Watch: Check AMC+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Son is an American Western drama television series based on the 2013 novel of the same name by Philipp Meyer that aired on AMC for two seasons. The show was created and developed by Meyer, Brian McGreevy, and Lee Shipman. Twenty episodes over two seasons aired from April 8, 2017, through June 29, 2019.
